description.value:
You're ability to shape shift is so incredible that it allows you to mimic another's very DNA.

As a Reaction to seeing a creature activate a Form you may memorize that Form for your own use, even if it is a Racial Form. You must have God Ki to copy a Godly Form. You keep this specific Form and may activate it at a later form, if you were to use this Feature again you may replace your current memorized Form, ending the Form if it was active.
